name: JPM Steel Fabrication
old_description: Founded in 2010, JPM Fabrication is a Veteran-Owned (VOSB) and Family-Operated business in NW Arkansas. We started from humble beginnings and have been blessed to gain the trust of our customers across the country.
about:
JPM Steel Fabrication was founded in 2010 in Bella Vista, Arkansas, as a veteran-owned small business (VOSB) and family-operated company. The founder, James P. McGary, an Army veteran who served in Iraq from 2003 to 2005, returned to his home region after a career in construction and concrete work. He recognized a shortage of skilled steel fabrication tradesmen in Northwest Arkansas and opened a shop with a single crew focused on storage solutions.

The company designs, fabricates, installs, maintains, repairs, and retrofits custom tension fabric storage buildings for bulk material storage. It also produces consumer products such as steel benches and fire pits, provides general contracting services for municipalities, and executes large-scale commercial customizations. From its Bella Vista facility, JPM employs multiple full-time steel fabricators, installation specialists, and office staff, serving customers across the continental United States. All buildings are engineer-approved and carry a 25-year warranty, with the first two years of maintenance included.

JPM serves agriculture (grain, hay, equipment storage), government and municipalities (salt, sand, maintenance buildings), waste and recycling, aviation (aircraft hangars), mining, equestrian facilities, port and intermodal transport, and railroad transportation. Clients include farms, city and state governments, commercial operations, and residential customers needing cost-effective dry storage.

McGary started the business to fill a local skills gap and to pass down trade traditions. The company emphasizes integrity, hands-on oversight by the founder on every project, and a "cut materials, not corners" philosophy. Its differentiators include the 25-year warranty, included maintenance, engineer-approved designs, and veteran-owned, family-operated values.
